years.name: The Hall of Beginnings
years.sub: General education • discovering why learning matters
years.lore: The first bell rings. Freshmen enter believing a finished assignment is the same thing as understanding.

years.name: The Library of Echoes
years.sub: General education • evidence, ethics, and collaboration
years.lore: The library returns every answer anyone has ever submitted. Only careful judgment distinguishes an echo from an insight.

years.name: The Tower of Trials
years.sub: Major courses • making real disciplinary decisions
years.lore: Advanced coursework turns generic answers to dust. To proceed, your character must own the reasoning behind their work.

years.name: The Hall of Ascension
years.lore: Graduation is in sight, but the final doors open only for work grounded in understanding rather than appearance.

framework.name: Purposeful AI friction
framework.description: Identify a plausible AI shortcut and create proportionate conditions, evidence, or accountability that protect the thinking students must practice.

framework.name: Meaningful practice
framework.description: Make learners practice a specific form of thinking and demonstrate it.

framework.name: A reason to engage
framework.description: Make purpose, relevance, audience, or meaningful choice visible.

framework.name: Reasonable conditions and friction
framework.description: Balance learning protection with workload, accessibility, support, and clear AI boundaries.
